H5T_STRING$new()

Create a string datatype

Usage

H5T_STRING$new(type = c("c", "fortran"), size = 1, id = NULL)

Arguments

type

The type to use. For a dataspace one of "simple", "scalar" or "null"; otherwise an object of class H5T.

size

Size of the string object. Set to Inf for variable size strings

id

internal use only

H5T_STRING$get_size()

Retrieves the length of the string, setting it to Inf it is of variable length. This function implements the HDF5-API function H5Tis_variable_str. Please see the documentation at https://support.hdfgroup.org/documentation/hdf5/latest/group___h5_t.html for details.

Usage

H5T_STRING$get_size(variable_as_inf = TRUE)

Arguments

variable_as_inf

Logical; should variable-length strings report their size as Inf.

H5T_STRING$get_cset()

This function implements the HDF5-API function H5Tget_cset. Please see the documentation at https://support.hdfgroup.org/documentation/hdf5/latest/group___h5_t.html for details.

Usage

H5T_STRING$get_cset()

H5T_STRING$set_cset()

This function implements the HDF5-API function H5Tset_cset. Please see the documentation at https://support.hdfgroup.org/documentation/hdf5/latest/group___h5_t.html for details.

Usage

H5T_STRING$set_cset(cset = c("unknown", "UTF-8"))

Arguments

cset

The character set to use; one of the H5T_CSET_* values in h5const.

H5T_STRING$set_strpad()

This function implements the HDF5-API function H5Tset_strpad. Please see the documentation at https://support.hdfgroup.org/documentation/hdf5/latest/group___h5_t.html for details.

Usage

H5T_STRING$set_strpad(strpad)

Arguments

strpad

The string padding to use; one of the H5T_STR_* values in h5const.

H5T_STRING$get_strpad()

This function implements the HDF5-API function H5Tget_strpad. Please see the documentation at https://support.hdfgroup.org/documentation/hdf5/latest/group___h5_t.html for details.

Usage

H5T_STRING$get_strpad()

H5T_STRING$describe()

Print a detailed description of the datatype; this is experimental

Usage

H5T_STRING$describe()

Examples

# fixed width string
str_flen <- H5T_STRING$new(size=100)
str_flen$is_vlen()
#> [1] FALSE
str_flen
#> Class: H5T_STRING
#> Datatype: H5T_STRING {
#>       STRSIZE 100;
#>       STRPAD H5T_STR_NULLTERM;
#>       CSET H5T_CSET_ASCII;
#>       CTYPE H5T_C_S1;
#>    }

# variable length string
str_vlen <- H5T_STRING$new(size=Inf)
str_vlen$is_vlen()
#> [1] TRUE
str_vlen
#> Class: H5T_STRING
#> Datatype: H5T_STRING {
#>       STRSIZE H5T_VARIABLE;
#>       STRPAD H5T_STR_NULLTERM;
#>       CSET H5T_CSET_ASCII;
#>       CTYPE H5T_C_S1;
#>    }
